Oncall bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall — p95 latency SLO tripped for routing-service. Automatic reroute kicked off.
Elena M: saw the alert, optimizer moved traffic eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 as fallback
Ajay: seeing oscillation; p95 keeps bouncing and triggering reroutes every ~45s
Kevin: also seeing model-variant drift after fallback — some hosts now running `quantized-v1`, others `standard-v1`
Elena M: that explains incorrect behavior; fallback should preserve variant. suspect routing-policy mismatch from yesterday's rollout
Ajay: grabbing logs now
Elena M: @Ajay check `routing.policy.variant_compat` and `prefer_same_variant` flags
Ajay: config shows `variant_preference: "compatibility"` but rollout flags differ per region (eu-west-1 has `prefer_same_variant: true`, us-west-2 unset)
SRE-Tony: FYI oncall handoff in 20m, leaving notes here
Oncall bot: INCIDENT-2026-1123 created (latency-slo-routing-oscillation). Severity: Sev2. Pages: SRE oncall.
Kevin: pasting relevant logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:43:21Z] routing-optimizer: trigger p95=1.22s threshold=1.00s -> initiating reroute to us-west-2
[2026-03-15T12:44:06Z] routing-optimizer: applied fallback variant=quantized-v1 in us-west-2
[2026-03-15T12:44:48Z] routing-optimizer: p95 rose -> reroute back to eu-west-1 variant=standard-v1
[2026-03-15T12:45:33Z] routing-optimizer: repeat reroute (oscillation detected)
```
Elena M: that's the loop. each reroute swaps variant, cold KV caches + quantization jitters spike latency, triggers another reroute.
Ajay: mitigation options: 1) pause auto-reroute 2) increase p95 threshold temporarily 3) pin region/variant until stable
Kevin: pause auto-reroute + pin variants seems fastest with least customer impact
Elena M: I can flip the optimizer `auto_failover` flag: `PATCH /admin/routing/config { "auto_failover": false }`
Ajay: applying now
Kevin: watching metrics
Oncall bot: @Ajay acknowledged the incident
Ajay: disabled `auto_failover` and applied `pin_variant=standard-v1` for eu-west-1 via control-plane API. command: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/pin -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","variant":"standard-v1"}'` -> 200 OK
Kevin: p95 dropped to ~0.95s after pins
Elena M: some customers in us-west-2 report 500s (error spike) — likely from mismatched binary/kv cache thrash
Customer Success Bot: Alert: acct-124 (fin-app) reported degraded responses; CS assigned to follow up
Ajay: digging host logs, seeing KV cache miss storm and CPU spin loops after variant swap. cache warming required when variants differ
Elena M: follow-ups: revert yesterday's routing-policy rollout, add pre-reroute compatibility check (variant + kv-schema), and add hysteresis to p95 trigger to avoid repeated reroutes
SRE-Tony: I'll take the oncall handoff at 12:50UTC. notes + runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-routing-oscillation
Elena M: @Kevin please coordinate rollback window with product and Optimize team
Kevin: pinged #product and created rollback ticket; will coordinate patch and release owner
Ajay: demoting incident to Sev3; removing loud pages. monitoring for 30m before close
Oncall bot: Incident status updated -> Mitigated (manual routing controls applied).
Elena M: great job everyone :thumbsup:
SRE-Tony: taking over for follow-up and postmortem draft
Elena M: adding timeline and config diffs to the incident doc; flagging Optimize for a fix to the reroute heuristic
